selection_source: Exposed state0-2 only; no validation outcomes inspected
rule: Estimate fixed-period calls by ceil(developer LAYA episode length/I); multiply by observed same-H median VLA service time. Choose minimum absolute error to full LAYA service cost; exact ties choose smaller I. No gate and no fitted model.
limitation: New fixed-period rollouts can change lengths and success; measured costs need not match the target. Do not retune on validation results.
